digest.component_or_area: authorship verification and commit history rewrite
propositions: Compacted authorship-ledger entries retain pre-rewrite commit SHAs that become stale after history rewrite, causing the verifier to misclassify authentic events as key-not-valid-at-era.

The verifier must treat stored ledger commit_sha as a cache and prefer resolution of the position against current history over the recorded SHA, falling back to recorded SHA only when position resolution fails.
A real-Git regression must prove that signed events remain verified after commit history rewrite when ledger positions are re-resolved against the current commit graph.
Live-event commit resolution, ledger schema, event bytes, and the null-commit recovery path must remain unchanged by the fix.
